observations: Unreproduced loss. In the first full multiprocess run, TestTwoPodsShortDropKeepsTheActivePod failed with '1 of 93 messages never reached their session within 30s: [evt-mp-0021 to ses_mp_drop_one]'. evt-mp-0021 was the first message published after the 2 s cut. pod-a reconnected both connections 2 s after the cut and logged no lease release, so the flag did not read down past the 3 s receive bound. The harness strips delivery lines from a failing run, so the log does not show where the message went. The row then passed 90 of 90 times at 3c1ab0d3 (8 alone, 18 three at a time, 64 eight at a time) and 18 of 18 at f08b5cc2 under the same load, and once more in the second full suite. The loaded runs used a harness copy that prints the full pod output. No earlier round recorded this row failing. I cannot tie it to this change or reproduce it, so there is no red test; it is named to the architect as a risk.

Fingerprint since a6ebeefc: internal/bus/nats.go, the new connected_flag_test.go, one sentence each in cmd/listener/README.md and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, and three docs/solutions files. Since f08b5cc2, also 0074091's two-line AGENTS.md wording.
The connUp map keeps one entry per connection that reports after the client replaced it, and the next install prunes it, so it stays small.
